title: Find everything needed to start a Task
statement: As a developer, I can open a Task and find its user story, a small essay, and the code that matters, so I can start it without reconstructing the context.

acceptance_criteria.statement: A Task's page links to the user story it leads to, and a Task with no story of its own shows the chain of Tasks leading there.
A Task can have a short essay, and its page shows it.
A Task can reference specific code, and its page shows each reference and opens that code.
